knowledge_gaps: Near-zero gating does not guarantee baseline equivalence: the added output LayerNorm can change SASRec scores even when the recent branch contributes nothing. Include a normalization-only control and specify gate initialization, normalization parameters, and recency-weight ordering.

Recency pooling may reinforce item similarity or popularity rather than current intent. The report does not establish whether repeated item IDs survive preprocessing or whether event-order recency reflects elapsed time.

Reproduction requires explicit fixed-gate values, checkpoint selection, diagnostic sampling, and a trial budget within 43,200 GPU-seconds. With only 200 validation users per category, small improvements require paired uncertainty analysis. Originality 4/10 is plausible; potential 7/10 remains speculative, and difficulty 3/10 understates integration and validation work.

Investigate zero-initialized residual gates, small sigmoid-gate gradients, and normalization-only ablations in sequential recommendation and residual Transformers.
